name: phd-cminus-then-live-retake
description: Red-team 2026-09-13: a student who earned a C- and is re-taking the course this semester. The §4.4.2 retake tie-break picked the last PASSING attempt, and a C- still counts as passed — so the C- stayed "the one counted", earned nothing under the 2026-09-12 credit floor, and the live retake was marked superseded, throwing its in-progress credit away (which also starved §4.5's candidacy-readiness gate). A live retake now wins over a passed attempt that earns no credit, exactly as it already did over a failed one.
